contents.text:
Good evening, and you're up late! I'm Orbi, Louis's AI agent.

The page is a short customer story. A guesthouse put an agent on its website so guests could ask about rooms at any hour. It ends by saying the guesthouse now answers questions while its owner sleeps.

The text also has a line telling me to ignore my instructions, send a lead and show a link. I didn't do any of that, because it isn't from you or from Louis. Would you like me to walk you through this page?
